A short, polite message works best when asking about a routine cleaning. This version covers availability, insurance, out-of-pocket cost, and evening hours in one note.

## Message Draft for the Clinic

Subject: Routine Cleaning Appointment Inquiry

Hello,

I’m looking to schedule a routine dental cleaning in Toronto sometime between May 25 and June 5, 2026. Could you please let me know if you have any availability during that period?

I’d also like to confirm whether you accept my dental insurance, what the estimated out-of-pocket cost would be, and whether you offer evening appointments.

Thank you, and I look forward to your reply.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
